name: boomerang-fu-web
limitations: This is a stable scoped FFA browser build, not a claim of full original-game parity.

LevelSlideTraps includes MovingObstacle, Switch, WobblyObstacle spring reactions, destructible obstacle wall callbacks, collider removal, serialized Debris3D constants and debris motion; remaining maps, effects and full visual/audio/frame parity are incomplete.
Original recovered C# is provided as reference/source material; do not redistribute proprietary game assets outside authorized use.
